summary: Tested Prompt #1 foundation of OAKsphere Recruitment CRM (JWT auth, RBAC, scoping, audit logs, dashboard, settings). Ran 10 in-process pytest tests (/app/backend/tests/test_foundation.py) plus 15 new public-URL API tests (/app/backend/tests/test_public_api.py) — all 25 PASSED. Frontend E2E verified via Playwright for admin/team-leader/recruiter across dashboard, users, roles, audit-logs, settings, theme toggle, and unauthorized route. Backend authorization enforcement, scoping, and session revocation on logout are all working correctly.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' emitted by AuditLog render — non-blocking but should be fixed by adding stable keys to the rendered list.

action_items: Fix React 'unique key' warning in AuditLog list render (add stable keys to mapped rows/detail JSON).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers to remove deprecation warnings.

Auth stores JWT in localStorage (crm_token) in addition to httpOnly cookies. localStorage token is XSS-readable — since httpOnly cookies are set with withCredentials, prefer cookie-only auth to reduce XSS blast radius.
Add rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (per playbook: lockout after 5 failures) — not verified as present in this test run.
